hypothesis: A fixed 0.5 shrink of the system's industry-neutral scoring transform may reduce industry-linked concentration while preserving more of the default A-leg score ordering than full shrink=1.0. This is a single exploratory contrast against R266; prior R98 industry-neutralization results and this strategy's extensive history are known, so neither discovery nor validation is an untouched holdout.

execution.only_changed_parameter: system neutralize override: industry_l1 with shrink=0.5
execution.implementation: StrategyBacktestService -> BacktestEngine -> existing scoring.neutralize_scoring_columns; candidate transforms are calculated inside each date's HS300 candidate universe.
execution.control: R266 finalized curve/trade caches; byte hashes checked before comparison

gates.P1: R266 equal-weight 3x/4x/5x curve and trade hashes match finalized R266 evidence; candidate caches have complete manifests and fresh system runs.
gates.P2: After running-panel reload, base strategy and its four referenced factors exist with zero strategy load errors.
gates.G1: 3x full-sample return is positive and retains at least 70% of R266 equal-weight return.
gates.G2: 3x maximum drawdown is no worse than -25%.
gates.G3: 3x rolling one-year positive-return rate is at least 70%.
gates.G5: 3x validation annualized return is at least 5%.
gates.G8: 3x validation return retains at least 70% of R266 validation return using the same prior-close-rebased calculation.
gates.R1: 3x full-sample Sharpe is no lower than R266 equal-weight control.
gates.R2: 3x maximum drawdown is no worse than R266 control by more than 3 percentage points.
gates.L1: 3x full-sample mean loss magnitude is at least 1 percentage point smaller than R266.
gates.L2: 3x validation-entry mean loss magnitude is at least 1 percentage point smaller than R266.
gates.L3: 3x full-sample worst completed trade is less negative than R266.
gates.L4: 3x validation-entry worst completed trade is less negative than R266.
gates.C2: Largest symbol net P&L share is at most 25%.
gates.C3: Top three symbols net P&L share is at most 55%.
gates.C4: Top five symbols net P&L share is at most 75%.
gates.C5: At least 8 distinct validation-entry symbols have positive P&L.
gates.C6: Largest industry gross-profit share is at most 45%.
gates.C7: Largest single-symbol loss is at most 20% of gross profit.
gates.C8: Validation-period largest symbol net P&L share is at most 35%.

decision_rule: The single shrink=0.5 candidate is rejected if any P/G/R/L/C gate fails. No threshold or variant changes after result exposure. Passing only allows separate research discussion; paper trading and production are not authorized by this round.
diagnostics_not_gates: Report scoring-variant trade count and all 3x/4x/5x curves/trades with SHA-256.
Report discovery/validation and rolling return statistics, top symbol and industry concentration, trade-loss distribution, and cost stress.
Compare full neutralization shrink=1.0 only as already-known R98 context; do not rerun it or tune shrink based on this result.
known_limitations: R98 previously tested full industry neutralization and industry plus size neutralization; those older results used pre-R125 holder data and 2x costs. R271 is an exploratory updated-score test, not a fresh confirmatory experiment.
R270's initial results had already been exposed before its final byte-identical recalculation; that audit does not restore independence.
R271 reuses a strategy and validation interval examined across many prior rounds; validation is not an untouched holdout.
Industry classification is a current snapshot, not point-in-time historical industry membership.
Score neutralization is not portfolio-level industry neutrality and does not enforce industry quotas.
Macro factor source data may be revised; historical HS300 membership is used.
Only 290 R266 baseline trades are available; concentration and tail estimates have sampling uncertainty.
Panel reload and passing historical backtest do not authorize paper or production deployment.
post_exposure_correction: The candidate strategy source and registrar changed after the first output had been calculated. This corrected run is explicitly exploratory and uses a new cache namespace; no part is described as confirmatory.
status_note: The R271 result was exposed before this source-locked rerun. This step audits cache/provenance reproducibility only, not independent performance confirmation.
